summary: Package the already owner-approved embedded Vibe-first UI into a uniquely identified R6 candidate based on the currently installed incremental-controls R6; preserve renderer behavior and exclude games.

evidence.scope: Only the existing firmware-embedded local UI source and candidate identity change. The 28 animation kernels, rendering/audio logic, controls, DDP, diagnostics behavior, security gates, and rollback path remain as in the installed R6.
